title: Warmth, texture and character
copy: An independent 2025 composition exploring Tobacco Vanille through warm sand, tobacco tones and atmosphere.

title: A setting built from texture
copy: The designer chose sand for its colour relationship with the bottle. The leaf adds a tobacco-inspired material association.

title: The bottle leads
copy: The fragrance bottle emerges first. Its existing label stays intact; no additional typography was introduced.

title: An impression of aroma
copy: Smoke and warm light suggest fragrance dispersed through the air. This is visual storytelling, not a physical scent effect.

title: A warm material palette
copy: The owner identifies #A88046, #E0A725, #31251B and #3B261E as the palette linking bottle, tobacco, sand and atmosphere.

title: Back to the original
copy: The layers return to the owner-supplied assembled artwork. Independent portfolio work, not an official brand campaign.
